$schemaNotes.purpose: Machine-readable spec for cmd/seed-demo (subcommands seed | verify). seed creates everything below; verify recomputes every expected number from this file plus each tenant's civil today and diffs it against the live report endpoints. Static tables under expectedAsOf are the human reference for 2026-09-06.

conventions.keys: Every object has a stable "key" (<tenantSlug>.<name>). Cross-references use keys; the seeder resolves them to server ids after creation and keeps a key->id map for verify.
conventions.dates: All legal dates are YYYY-MM-DD civil dates. completedOn is a civil date in the TENANT timezone; the seeder stores completed_at = completedOn at completedAtLocalTime (default 10:00) in tenants.timezone, converted to UTC.
conventions.completionEscapeHatch: Two database-level steps; everything else is HTTP as the seeded users. (a) Before the API calls: INSERT the tenant, its admin user (argon2id hash, status=active), the tenant-wide tenant_admin grant and the three predefined data templates — exactly what cmd/seed-admin does, because no HTTP endpoint creates a tenant. (b) After the API calls: UPDATE task_instances SET completed_at (and approved_at / submitted_at for via=approve) inside a transaction that first runs SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', <tenantId>, true) — the API always stamps NOW(). submitted_at = submittedOn 10:00 local; approved_at = completed_at.
conventions.creationOrder: tenant + admin + grant + predefined templates (SQL) -> entities (parents before children) -> obligation types -> members (a scoped grant needs its scopeEntity to exist already, which is why entities precede users despite the JSON listing users first) -> entity obligations -> workflows + workflow tasks -> start -> instance actions (PUT, documents, submit, approve) -> workflow final status -> the completed_at SQL back-dating.
conventions.passwords: Demo-only, >= 12 chars, printed in docs/testing/seed-dataset.md. Admin users are inserted like cmd/seed-admin (argon2id, active, tenant-wide tenant_admin grant, predefined data templates). Every other user: POST /members (as admin) -> POST /auth/accept-invite {token,password} -> POST /auth/login. Members with status=disabled are activated first, then PUT /members/{id} {name,status:"disabled"} by the admin.
conventions.emails: users.email is globally unique: <role>@<slug>.test (the second acme preparer is preparer-fr@acme-demo.test). The acme tenant's slug is acme-demo, NOT acme, so that the dataset can be seeded into a database on which deployment/docker `docker compose run --rm seed` has already created its default acme / admin@acme.test tenant (tenants.slug and users.email are both unique).

tenant.slug/name/timezone: INSERT INTO tenants (slug,name,timezone) exactly as cmd/seed-admin does; timezone is the IANA zone the report SQL and the UI use for "today".
tenant.admin: The tenant_admin created with the tenant (SQL). Also the actor for: entities, obligation types, member invites, member disable, PUT /tenant (not needed), data-template lookup.
tenant.users[]: role: manager|preparer|reviewer|viewer. scopeEntity: null = tenant-wide grant, else the entity key whose subtree the grant is scoped to (writes only; reads stay tenant-wide). status: active|disabled.

$schemaNotes.entities[]: POST /entities as admin, in list order (parents before children). country is free text (the UI select sends full names). fiscalCalendarPattern is always standard here; financialYearEnd MM-DD. financialYear of a workflow = the calendar year the fiscal year ENDS in (FYE 03-31, FY2026 = 2025-04-01..2026-03-31; M1 = April, Q1 = Apr-Jun).
$schemaNotes.obligationTypes[]: POST /obligation-types as admin. template drives the report taxType (VAT|CIT|WHT|TP|Custom); code unique per tenant.
$schemaNotes.entityObligations[]: POST /entity-obligations as the tenant manager (initech: admin). EXACTLY one per (entity, obligationType). Only paymentOffset / paymentFixedDates / weekendAdjustment of deadlineRule are consumed by the generator (payment deadline); filingOffset/fixedDates are stored for the UI only. paymentOffset: period end + months (month-end clamped) + days, then weekend adjustment (the rule's own, else the workflow's). paymentFixedDates: first MM-DD on/after the period end (that year, else next), NO weekend adjustment. Neither: payment = filing deadline.

workflows[].creation: POST /workflows as the tenant manager (initech: admin) with status draft, then one POST /workflow-tasks per template (dataTemplate VAT|CIT|WHT resolves to the tenant's predefined template of that templateType via GET /data-templates; null = no template). Then, when lifecycle.start is true, POST /workflows/{id}/start (no overrides) as the manager; finally, when lifecycle.finalStatus is completed or archived, PUT /workflows/{id} (full body + status) as the manager AFTER all instance actions. finalStatus draft = never started (0 instances).
workflows[].category=project: Requires product fix F6: start generates one instance per template with periodCode PROJECT, periodEndDate = filingDeadline = endDate and paymentDeadline = NULL (modules/taskinstances/usecases/generator.go: project workflows have no payment deadline, and a paymentDeadline task override is refused with a 400); due = endDate ± template offset. entity may be null (tenant-level; needs a tenant-wide writer).
workflows[].dueDateRule: filingDeadline = weekendAdjust(periodEnd ± offset). reference is ignored by the generator (always period end).
workflows[].templates[]: dueDateReference period_end|filing_deadline|payment_deadline; due = reference ± offset with NO weekend adjustment. approvalRequired=true only on Review templates.
workflows[].writer/approver: writer = the user whose session performs PUT /task-instances/{id} (status, assignee, taxData, notes), POST .../submit-for-approval and document uploads for this workflow. approver = the user whose session performs POST .../approve (must differ from writer; SoD). The acme FR workflows use the FR-scoped preparer to prove scoped writes succeed inside the subtree.
workflows[].instances[]: Only instances that deviate from the generated default (status not_started, no assignee, no data) are listed; every unlisted (period, task) is left untouched. Fields: status not_started|in_progress|in_review|blocked|pending_approval|completed; via put|submit|approve (put = PUT status; submit = PUT (assignee/notes) then POST submit-for-approval by writer, leaving pending_approval; approve = PUT (assignee) then submit by writer then approve by approver); assignee = user key set on the PUT (must be an active human member); completedOn / completedAtLocalTime / submittedOn as above; completedAtUtc = the exact instant the escape hatch must write for completed_at, given only where the tenant-zone civil date differs from the UTC one (it must equal completedOn at completedAtLocalTime in tenants.timezone — verify asserts the stored instant, not just the derived civil date, so a seeder that writes the civil date with a Z suffix is caught); taxData = JSON object stored via PUT (numbers are JSON numbers; with a template attached keys must be template field ids — product fix F1 renames the predefined ids to the report keys); taxDataStatus draft|final; notes = free text on the PUT.
workflows[].putOrder: Exactly one PUT per listed instance carrying status (for via=submit/approve: in_progress), assigneeId, notes, taxData, taxDataStatus together; then documents; then submit; then approve; then the completed_at escape hatch.
workflows[].documents[]: POST /workflows/{id}/documents multipart as the writer, at the position putOrder gives (after the instance PUT, before submit/approve — an instance that is pending_approval or approved freezes its documents with a 409). kind pdf|text|csv: the seeder generates a tiny valid file of that MIME type. newVersion=true additionally POSTs /documents/{id}/versions once with the same kind.

$schemaNotes.coverageGaps: Declared, deliberate gaps — this dataset does NOT exercise: fiscal calendars other than standard (445 / 454 / 544 / 13-period / weekly / custom) and therefore not the P1..P13, W1..W52/53 or custom period codes, nor the task_instances.period_code VARCHAR(10) vs the 16-char selectedPeriods limit; periodicities other than monthly / quarterly / annual (no bi-annual H1/H2, no consolidated-annual CY1); a participating workflow with no obligation type or a Custom-template obligation carrying tax data, so tax-financial's 'other' branch is reached only through TP and the 'unknown' / 'Unknown Obligation' / taxType='' group keys never appear. Covered by the engine's own unit tests and listed in docs/testing/test-plan.md §7 + D18 instead; adding any of them here would change every expected number in expectedAsOf.
$schemaNotes.expectedAsOf: expectedAsOf["2026-09-06"][tenantKey] = the numbers the reports must return when every tenant's civil today is 2026-09-06 (valid for any tenant-today in validityWindow for the heatmap / compliance / financial / export / workflow-stats numbers; dashboard dueToday/thisWeek only for exactly 2026-09-06). Keys of the maps are the query strings (entity/obligation keys in place of ids). Heatmap cells are keyed "<entityKey>|<colId>" where colId is the period code (period view) or the obligation type key (tax-type view). verify MUST recompute these from the rules, not read them; they are the human cross-check.
$schemaNotes.recomputationRule: class(D) = completed && completed_at != null ? (completedDate_in_tenant_zone <= D ? on_time : late) : (D < tenantToday ? missed : not_due). Heatmap uses D = due_date (overdue = missed, completedLate = late; cell red if overdue>0 or completedLate>0, green if completed==total, else amber); compliance-status uses D = filing_deadline. Only workflows with status active|completed and category recurring participate in those two and in tax-financial (tax_data non-empty). Export and task-instances/workflow-stats include every workflow and every instance. Dashboard: overdue = not completed && due < today; dueToday = due == today; thisWeek = today < due <= Saturday of today's week; awaitingApproval = pending_approval; completionRate = round(100 * sum(completedTasks)/sum(totalTasks)) over workflow-stats.
$schemaNotes.productFixesRequired: F1 (predefined template field ids = report keys), F2 (in_review vocabulary in UI), F3 (proxy limit=100 on lists), F4 (tax-financial period order), F5 (compliance summary unfiltered), F6 (project workflow instances), F8 (compliance-status filingDate in tenant zone). The dataset seeds without F2/F3/F4/F5/F8; F1 and F6 are prerequisites for seeding (F1: Prepare taxData keys; F6: project instances).

validityWindow.note: No due/filing/payment date falls strictly inside (from-1, to); with tenant-today anywhere in [from, to] every classification is unchanged (a deadline equal to today is not_due). Dashboard dueToday/thisWeek assume today = asOf exactly.
